summary: Blaine County, ID: BLM two-story lookout built 1963, last staffed 1998, demolished 2014; the summit now has antennas and a road to the top.

facts.design: BLM-designed two-story lookout house with a concrete base and frame cab
facts.status_note: Demolished in 2014; a September 2020 climbing guide says the summit has antenna installations

access.note: A road from Bellevue reaches the summit; 4WD recommended; land is mixed BLM, state and private, so check the BLM Fairfield map

events.note: Two-story lookout house designed by the BLM, with a concrete base and frame cab
Mr. and Mrs. Louis Anderson are the known lookouts for 1963 to 1974; Idaho Fire Lookouts also names Thora Anderson

Demolished in 2014; Forest Lookouts dates the removal to September 2014
Climbing guide updated September 2020 describes antenna installations at the summit and a road to the top

corrections.why: The FFLA Idaho list has one Bell Mountain in Idaho, in Blaine County, at 43.43099, -114.11104. Firelookout.com places the lookout 12 miles southeast of Hailey. The brief's point is about 120 km northeast of Hailey.
The sources say demolished or removed in 2014. None says the lookout was destroyed by fire or other damage.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Firelookout.com names only Mr. and Mrs. Louis Anderson for 1963 to 1974. Idaho Fire Lookouts also names Thora Anderson. The story names the Andersons and notes the second name.
The brief's point is about 120 km from the Blaine County site. The FFLA point matches firelookout.com's description of a site 12 miles southeast of Hailey.

notes_for_editor: Duplicate record: us-id-bell-mountain-2 already has research and a story for this same lookout, with coordinates 43.431, -114.111. The brief's coordinates are wrong. Merge the two before publishing. Present-day state rests on one climbing guide updated September 2020; no recent photo or BLM record was read. Access 'public' comes from the guide and the drive-up notes, so check BLM land status before a stronger claim. The FFLA list gives '2-Story cab' with no build year, so 1963 comes from the three history sites.
